family: all rational rank-one updates G=I+u v^T with supp(u) union supp(v) equal to the four selected channels
normalization: Diagonal similarity normalizes u_i=1 on supp(u) and v_j=1 on supp(v) minus supp(u); the only free diagonal products are x_i=u_i*v_i on the overlap. This preserves all supports and tariff.

support_equations.classification_method: Enumerate all nonempty membership patterns S,T with S union T equal to the block; for each overlap, solve every source/inverse diagonal zero-flag system over Q and avoid the finite forbidden hyperplanes with a degree-bounded exact parameter.
support_equations.inverse_diagonal_zero_i: 1 + sum_{j != i, j in overlap} x_j = 0
support_equations.invertible_denominator: 1 + sum_{i in supp(u) intersect supp(v)} x_i != 0
support_equations.off_diagonal: G_ij and G^-1_ij are nonzero exactly on the rectangle supp(u) x supp(v), away from the diagonal
support_equations.source_diagonal_zero_i: x_i = -1 for i in the overlap
